notes: The standard library declares extension Array : @unchecked Sendable where Element : Sendable (Swift.swiftinterface, MacOSX27.0.sdk). Apple's documentation data puts other conditions on Array's conformances, such as Sendable when Element conforms to IntentValueConvertible. A generic type that stores [Item] can be Sendable only where Item is Sendable. Swift 5 mode does not diagnose the missing conformance, so this case needs -swift-version 6.
